title: Multiplication factor k for digested sludge (Figure 6.2 lower curve)
applicability: Simplified equation of the lower curve of Figure 6.2, labelled 'Digested sludge' in the figure and printed directly below the undigested-sludge line.
notes: Ep528-2 is a service locator, not a printed equation number.

The superscript 2 is printed and visible in the page image, but the PDF text layer at that position holds only a newline character, so the native text reads '0.0354P - 0.0699P + 1.0858'. The image form with the exponent is transcribed; the text-layer form is not.
The curve this equation belongs to is labelled 'Digested sludge' in Figure 6.2; the equation line itself reads 'k for digested sludge'; retained.
No reordering or simplification of the printed polynomial is applied.
